module fsm (
  input clk,
  input reset,
  input [7:0] in,
  output reg done,
  output reg [23:0] out_bytes,
  output reg [1:0] state
);
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
      done <= 0;
      state <= 0;
    end else begin
      case (state)
        0: if (in[3] == 1) begin state <= 1; end
        1: if (in[3] == 0) begin state <= 0; end
           else if (in[2] == 1) begin state <= 2; end
        2: if (in[2] == 0) begin state <= 0; done <= 1; end
           else if (in[3] == 1) begin state <= 1; end
      endcase
    end
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) out_bytes <= 24'h0;
    else if (state == 0 && in[3] == 1) out_bytes[23:16] <= in;
    else if (state == 1 && in[3] == 0) out_bytes[15:8] <= in;
    else if (state == 2 && in[2] == 0) out_bytes[7:0] <= in;
  end
endmodule
